section_header: AUTOMATIC TRANSMISSION — Component Groups (Transmission Case and Rear Brake Pistons)
title: REMOVE OUTER PISTON AND REACTION SLEEVE WITH COMPRESSED AIR / INSPECTION OF CASE COMPONENT GROUP

content.description: Illustration showing removal of adapter from transmission case

content.text: 3. REMOVE OUTER PISTON AND REACTION SLEEVE WITH COMPRESSED AIR

content.description: Illustration showing placement of shop rags and application of compressed air to piston

content.text: (b) Place several clean shop rags on the piston to catch the piston and sleeve. To pop them out, apply compressed air to the outer and inner piston oil holes.

content.description: Illustration showing use of needle-nose pliers to lift out piston from case

content.text: If the piston and sleeve do not pop out with the compressed air:
(c) Using needle-nose pliers, lift out the piston from the case.

content.description: Illustration showing insertion of two long hooks behind reaction sleeve to lift inner piston

content.text: (d) Insert two long hooks behind the reaction sleeve and gradually lift it out of the case.
(e) Using hooks, lift the inner piston out of the case in the same manner.
4. REMOVE O-RINGS FROM OUTER AND INNER PISTONS AND REACTION SLEEVE
REPLACEMENT OF MANUAL SHAFT OIL SEALS

content.description: Illustration showing removal and installation of manual shaft oil seals using screwdriver and SST tool

content.text: (a) Remove the manual shaft oil seals with a screwdriver.
(b) Drive in new left and right oil seals with SST.
